newsitem.title: USA: Exide says European chairman resigns.
newsitem.headline: Exide says European chairman resigns.

text.p: Exide Corp said Monday that George Tinker, chairman of Exide Holdings Europe, will resign effective May 16 to pursue other interests.

Exide, one of the world's largest manufacturers of automotive and industrial batteries, said Tinker's resignation follows the completion of his agreed-upon assignments relating to the consolidation of Exide's European acquisitions.

"When we asked George to assume the role of chairman of Exide Europe, we agreed it would be for only a limited period of time," Exide Chairman Arthur Hawkins said in a statement "Therefore, I accept, and appreciate, George's desire to return to other pursuits which he has put on hold while serving at Exide."
Hawkins added, however, that Tinker has agreed to continue to work with Exide as a consultant focusing on customer and industry relations.
